text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our first three years with Inari One. 
Those festival-like days had finally come 
to an end—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the festival never truly ends. 
The sacred and the mundane constantly 
cycle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fireworks she launched, along with 
their heat and brilliance, continue to 
live on in everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whenever that running is spoken of, people 
will surely hear within their hearts the 
fierce, spirited sounds of that festival 
music—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me! Is Trainer here?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
My apologies! I had an important and 
relatively urgent matter, so I came to 
speak with you directly!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations! An Umamusume training 
academy in America has reached out to 
scout you!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(H-Hey now. I heard an unusual voice and 
wondered what was up, but this is—)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Affirmative! This is in recognition of 
your achievement in guiding Inari One to 
become Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Precious! Such a rare chance comes along 
once in a blue moon, so I leave the 
decision entirely up to you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, the deadline to reply is short! 
Please make a decision as soon as 
possible!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I pondered what to do about this 
sudden turn of events, time flew by in an 
instant—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Yo, Boss! Working hard as ever today, I 
see!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Yo, Boss! Working hard as ever today, I 
see!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ah, nah, how do I put it... I had some 
business, y'know. Came all the way here 
for it, but somehow I totally forgot what 
it was—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Get outta here!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Boss! Truth is, I happened to 
overhear your talk with the Chairwoman 
outside just now...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Sis! Truth is, I happened to 
overhear your talk with the Chairwoman 
outside just now...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So... I came here to talk about that.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …………Go head to America.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's a once-in-a-lifetime chance, right? 
Way to go! It's the perfect opportunity to 
take flight onto the world stage!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If Boss makes it big after this, does that 
mean I'm an Umamusume coached by a 
world-class Trainer?! Whoa, that's 
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If Big Sis makes it big after this, does 
that mean I'm an Umamusume coached by a 
world-class Trainer?! Whoa, that's 
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Everyone back home's gonna be blown away. 
The boss's heart might pop right outta his 
chest!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've known the boss was amazing all 
along, so in a way, this is only natural—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've always known how amazing Big 
Sis is, so in a way, this much is to be 
expected—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …………I can't stop her.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Because, ya know, when I left for Tracen 
Academy... the boss was the one who saw me 
off, too."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just like the boss gave me courage back 
then... I was hoping... I could do the 
same...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's... what I thought...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Inari One back then and who I am today 
are totally different.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back then, Inari One harbored a true 
desire to run in the Central races. The 
boss understood that all too well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet, I'm different. I am—
choice_data_list:
I want to stay as Inari One's trainer for 
longer.
I want to keep being your Trainer, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to walk alongside Inari One even 
more as her Trainer. I want to take on 
challenges, have quarrels, and celebrate 
festivals together."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's so much, so much I still want to 
do. So many challenges I want to take on. 
My path with Inari One isn't over yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if an offer to go to America came 
up, that would be—"
choice_data_list: I'm not going unless Inari comes with me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Boss—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Big Sis—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I say it to her once more. As 
her partner, straight and without 
hesitation."
choice_data_list:
Let's keep putting on festivals together 
from now on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because festivals are—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Can't do it alone, after all.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, since you put it like that! It 
wouldn't be stylish of me not to deliver!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's start from here, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's start from here, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—...About the super-duper-mega road trip 
feud between Inari One and her Trainer 
that nobody knows about yet!!!!
